001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
011import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
012import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
013
014/**
015 * The largest element in the set. Does nothing if the set is empty.
016 *
017 * TODO: constraint based on the cardinality of the set. For example:
018 * env={0,1,2,3}, card={2,3} then clearly the largest element is at least 1.
019 *
020 * @author jimmy
021 */
022public class PropSetMax extends Propagator<Variable> {
023
024    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
025
026    private final SetVar set;
027    private final IntVar setCard;
028    private final IntVar max;
029
030    public PropSetMax(SetVar set, IntVar setCard, IntVar max) {
031        super(new Variable[]{set, setCard, max}, PropagatorPriority.UNARY, false);
032        this.set = set;
033        this.setCard = setCard;
034        this.max = max;
035    }
036
037    private boolean isSetVar(int idx) {
038        return idx == 0;
039    }
040
041    private boolean isSetCardVar(int idx) {
042        return idx == 1;
043    }
044
045    private boolean isMaxVar(int idx) {
046        return idx == 2;
047    }
048
049    @Override
050    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
051        if (isSetVar(vIdx)) {
052            return SetEventType.all();
053        }
054        if (isSetCardVar(vIdx)) {
055            return IntEventType.INCLOW.getMask() + IntEventType.instantiation();
056        }
057        assert isMaxVar(vIdx);
058        return IntEventType.all();
059    }
060
061    int in() {
062        int in = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
063        ISetIterator iter = set.getUB().iterator();
064        while (iter.hasNext()) {
065            int i = iter.nextInt();
066            if (max.contains(i)) {
067                if (in != Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
068                    return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
069                }
070                in = i;
071            }
072        }
073        return in;
074    }
075
076    @Override
077    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
078        if (setCard.getLB() > 0) {
079            if (set.getUB().size() > 0) {
080                max.updateUpperBound(set.getUB().max(), this);
081            }
082            int lim = setCard.getLB() - 1;
083            if (lim < set.getUB().size()) {
084                max.updateLowerBound(PropUtil.getEnv(set, lim), this);
085            }
086            if (set.getLB().size() > 0) {
087                max.updateLowerBound(set.getLB().max(), this);
088            }
089            int in = in();
090            if (in != Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
091                max.instantiateTo(in, this);
092            }
093            int ub = max.getUB();
094            ISetIterator iter = set.getUB().iterator();
095            while (iter.hasNext()) {
096                int i = iter.nextInt();
097                if (i > ub) {
098                    set.remove(i, this);
099                }
100            }
101            if (max.isInstantiated()) {
102                set.force(max.getValue(), this);
103                setPassive();
104            }
105        } else if (setCard.getUB() > 0) {
106            if (!PropUtil.isDomIntersectEnv(max, set)) {
107                setCard.instantiateTo(0, this);
108            } else if (set.getLB().size() > 0) {
109                int m = max.getUB();
110                int k = set.getLB().min();
111                if (m < k) {
112                    setCard.instantiateTo(0, this);
113                }
114            }
115        }
116    }
117
118    @Override
119    public ESat isEntailed() {
120        if (setCard.getLB() > 0) {
121            if (!PropUtil.isDomIntersectEnv(max, set)) {
122                return ESat.FALSE;
123            }
124            if (set.getLB().size() > 0) {
125                int m = max.getUB();
126                int k = set.getLB().max();
127                if (m < k) {
128                    return ESat.FALSE;
129                }
130                int e = set.getUB().max();
131                if (max.isInstantiated() && m == e && m == k) {
132                    return ESat.TRUE;
133                }
134            }
135        }
136        return setCard.isInstantiatedTo(0) ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
137    }
138
139    @Override
140    public String toString() {
141        return "max(" + set + ", " + setCard + ", " + max + ")";
142    }
143}
